company.name: Loyyal
company.shortDescription: Loyyal empowers businesses to build, scale, & monetize loyalty programs via AI and blockchain, connecting enterprises, SMEs & rewards.
company.description:
Loyyal leverages blockchain and smart contract technology to provide loyalty and rewards network infrastructure solutions.

It introduces interoperability to the currently fragmented industry, multi-branded coalitions, superior program liability management and dynamic issuance/redemption options customized for each unique relationship.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,500,000 to $23,905,201, a 3.68x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (-17 over 90 days) and market heat at 22 (-58).
